id.description: The project's id in its portfolio.json (FR-11).

thumbnail.description: Path of the card image, for example assets/img/projects/sd-01/thumbnail.png. Needs thumbnailAlt.

thumbnailAlt.description: Text alternative for the card image.

hidden.description: True to keep the project off the site: no card and no case study page.

status.description: Short note shown on the card and the case study, for example Pending quality review. The value Complete is shown in green.

demo.description: Slug of an entry in data/demos.json.

repo.description: GitHub repository name, used to add live GitHub data to the card.

codeUrl.description: Full URL of the source repository.
